name: Macropod
oneLiner: AUDM is Macropod's centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 by approved clients and backed by AUD cash held in trust at a Big 4 Australian bank.
collateral: Australian dollar cash held 1:1 in the AUDM Trust Class A Reserve at Westpac Banking Corporation, as reported in Macropod's reserve verification as at 1 September 2026
pegMechanism: Approved Macropod clients deposit AUD into the reserve to mint AUDM and return AUDM to Macropod for 1:1 AUD redemption by bank transfer, subject to onboarding, KYC/AML, sanctions, and compliance checks

proofOfReserves.provider: Catena Digital Pty Ltd t/a Macropod Global issuer-signed monthly reserve verification. latestReport tracks the 1 September 2026 self-verification supporting the authored composition. Hall Chadwick Melbourne Audit separately issued a quarterly agreed-upon-procedures report covering 30 June 2026 on 5 August 2026 (ASRS 4400, no opinion expressed; independence was not required); that older engagement remains a source reference and does not attest the September composition.
